author_choice: One sampled CFS shipment represents one synthetic job-equivalent
conversion_rule: D_l = 1 for each unique sampled SHIPMT_ID; weight is not converted to demand
interpretation: One unit of an order entails one pickup and one delivery equivalent; these are not two units of order demand. This is not an observed stop count or an indivisible parcel model.

time_units.period: 60 minutes in the initial LA-SF design
time_units.b: minutes per square root of job-equivalents
time_units.vehicle_input_rate: currency per vehicle-hour, divided by 60 once

synthetic_parameter_policy.selection_basis: Declared design before new optimization; not selected to improve observed results

sampling.preferred_method: Existing per-direction WGT_FACTOR weighted sampling without replacement from SQLite
sampling.baseline_direction_allocation: balanced by design; disclose and preserve observed direction totals separately
sampling.processed_json_scope: Seeded sampling from an existing processed pool is a provenance/replay check, not a new weighted sample from the full CFS population
sampling.time_windows: Existing synthetic window generator, release also defines revelation; never describe these as observed CFS times
sampling.corridor_tau: Calibrate once from the entire eligible city pair, freeze across seeds; initial LA-SF source recommendation is 9 periods
sampling.fixed_instance_export: P1: write immutable per-seed order JSON and SHA256 before comparative solves

forbidden_interpretations: job capacity is physical truck weight capacity
